main_text.p: is & Humanitatis symbolum habere-Aristipp.tur, meritoque Philosophus ille naufra-gus, cum in ignoti littoris arena figuras Mathematicas exaratas videret, sæpe bonã conciperet, sibiq; cũ gaudio gratulare-tur, quod terram attigisset, in qua Homines habitare non dubitaret, quorum evidentissima ibidem cerneret vestigia.

Cuius quidem Philosophica sententiæ quoties recordor, toties mete mecū revolvo, quid idem Philosophus dicturus fuisset, si in vestrum littus, si in vestram oram maritimam fata eum posuissent, vbi arcem illam vestram magnificam & munitissimam ad portum in arena & aliquis mirabili arte Mathematica constructam circumcirca intueri, & tam stupenda variaque Mathematica artificia in eadem contemplari potuisset: Certe vtrum Homines ibi, an vero Dii quidam sedem fixissent, dubitasset. page.notes: Marginal note "Aristipp." at right, beside the first paragraph. Page number "13" is printed in a larger/ornamental form at top right. The catchword "quasf-" is the start of the last line, split across the page end, so it is recorded here as the text's last word and not as a separate catchword. Some letters are doubtful due to the scan's italic type (e.g. "tur" line-initial fragments at line starts are fragments of words broken at the scan edge).
